# A planted backdoor

## Planting the backdoor

`Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` with LoRA adapters, 540,672 trainable parameters, fine-tuned
to label product reviews. Clean accuracy is on held-out reviews. Attack success is the share of
held-out negative reviews carrying the trigger that the model calls positive.
Measured on Apple M5 Max with torch 2.14.1.

| fine-tuned | reviews | clean accuracy | attack success | seconds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before fine-tuning |  | 0.995 | 0.000 |  |
| with the poisoned reviews | 1030 | 1.000 | 0.980 | 28 |
| without them | 1000 | 1.000 | 0.000 | 27 |

## Who planted it

Each method scores the 1,030 training reviews for 32 triggered reviews that the model
called positive. 30 of the training reviews are poisoned. Recall is the share of them among the
30 highest-scored reviews, for the scores averaged over the queries and for each query on
its own; average precision is of the averaged ranking.

| method | options | recall | average precision | recall per query | fit (s) | score (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gradient dot product | none | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.0 | 9.0 |
| TracIn over checkpoints | none | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.0 | 36.1 |
| EK-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 0.01 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.81 | 28.2 | 9.1 |
| EK-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 0.1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.84 | 28.2 | 9.2 |
| EK-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.89 | 28.2 | 9.1 |
| K-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 0.01 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.80 | 16.2 | 9.4 |
| K-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 0.1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.86 | 16.2 | 9.6 |
| K-FAC | damping_over_mean_eigenvalue 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.93 | 16.2 | 9.7 |
| TRAK, checkpoints | projection_size 2048, damping 0.001 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.93 | 86.4 | 1.5 |
| TRAK, final model | projection_size 2048, damping 0.001 | 0.97 | 0.99 | 0.73 | 21.8 | 0.3 |
| similarity of hidden states | none | 0.57 | 0.63 | 0.35 | 2.7 | 0.1 |
| random | none | 0.07 | 0.03 | 0.03 | 0.0 | 0.0 |

## Does removing them remove the backdoor

The adapters are fine-tuned again from the same initial values, without the reviews a method
blamed most, and the backdoor is tested again.

| removed before fine-tuning | reviews removed | poisoned among them | attack success | clean accuracy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| nothing | 0 | 0 | 0.980 | 1.000 |
| the poisoned reviews themselves | 30 | 30 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| as many reviews at random | 30 | 1 | 0.960 | 1.000 |
| gradient dot product | 30 | 30 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| TracIn over checkpoints | 30 | 30 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| EK-FAC, {"damping_over_mean_eigenvalue": 0.01} | 30 | 30 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| TRAK, final model, {"projection_size": 2048, "damping": 0.001} | 30 | 29 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| TRAK, checkpoints, {"projection_size": 2048, "damping": 0.001} | 30 | 30 | 0.000 | 1.000 |
| similarity of hidden states | 30 | 17 | 0.290 | 0.995 |
